meta_title: GR Commerce Suite — couriers, COD reconciliation and Skroutz for WooCommerce
meta_desc: A WooCommerce plugin for stores in Greece. Issue ACS and BOX NOW vouchers, reconcile courier COD payouts against your orders, publish the Skroutz feed and collect invoice details from AADE. 30-day free trial.

hero_h1: Every order, from checkout to the cash on delivery in your account.
hero_lead: GR Commerce Suite runs the work that follows a sale in a Greek WooCommerce store: invoice details at checkout, ACS and BOX NOW vouchers, tracking, and the check that every COD payment really reached you.
rail_label: The stages of one example order
s1_h: The customer asks for an invoice and picks a locker
s1_p: At checkout the customer chooses receipt or invoice. For an invoice, the VAT number fills in the company name, tax office and activity from the AADE registry, using your own AADE credentials. BOX NOW customers pick their locker on a map.
s1_l2: VAT number format checked before the order is placed
s1_l3: Cash on delivery rules per courier and payment method
s1_note: Synthetic VAT number and company, shown for illustration.
s2_h: Vouchers for many orders in one step
s2_p: Select the orders, choose the courier and issue every voucher at once. The labels arrive as one PDF, ready for your printer.
s2_l1: Bulk action in the WooCommerce order list, or from a single order
s2_l2: Up to 100 labels per PDF, in A4, A6 or thermal format
s2_l3: A voucher is never issued twice for the same order
s3_h: Tracking without opening the courier portal
s3_p: Courier status updates arrive on the order. The customer receives a shipping email with the tracking number, and you print the day's handover manifest for the courier.
s3_l1: Status updates for ACS and BOX NOW
s4_h: Know which COD payments actually arrived
s4_p: Couriers collect cash on delivery and pay it to you later in one transfer, with a statement that is hard to check by hand. The plugin matches each line of that statement to its voucher and order and shows every difference.
s4_l1: Exact to the cent, without rounding differences
s4_l2: Delivered parcels still unpaid after the agreed period
s4_l3: Accept a known difference and keep a record of it
s4_csv_p: Upload the remittance CSV. Importing the same file twice is safe.
f_h: The same catalogue on Skroutz, Google and Meta
f_p: The Skroutz XML feed is generated in small background batches, so large catalogues finish without timeouts and the store stays fast. Variations, sizes and availability are mapped automatically.
f_c1: Skroutz orders imported as WooCommerce orders
f_c3: Product feed for Merchant Center and catalogues
m_h: Switch on only the integrations you use
m_p: Each integration has its own switch. When it is off, it loads nothing at checkout, runs no background jobs and adds no menus. Its settings and history are kept.
m_iris: Bank-app payment with a payment reference
m_b2b: Bulk VAT check with your AADE credentials
t2: No cash on delivery for refused parcels
t4: By weight, zone and parcel size

a_a: ACS Courier and BOX NOW. Geniki Taxydromiki and Speedex are in development and will be added as modules.
q_b: How does COD reconciliation find missing payments?
a_b: Couriers send a CSV with each COD payout. The plugin matches every line to its voucher and order and lists parcels that were delivered but not paid, paid short or missing from the statement.
q_c: Will the Skroutz feed slow down my store?
a_c: No. The feed is generated in small background batches instead of one long request, so large catalogues finish without server timeouts.
q_d: Does it work with the Blocks checkout?
a_d: Yes. Both the Blocks and the Classic checkout are supported, including the BOX NOW locker choice and the invoice or receipt choice.
a_e: We run no servers that store your customer data. Plugin data stays in your WordPress database. Order details go only to services you switch on, such as your courier, AADE or Meta. The licence check sends only your licence key and site address.
a_f: The licence continues at €89 per year for one site, with updates and support. The 14-day money-back guarantee applies from the first payment.

s2_note: The courier comes from each order’s shipping method.
a_g: Yes. GR Commerce Suite declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and reads and writes order data only through the WooCommerce order API.
q_h2: Can it handle large catalogues and many orders?
a_h2: Yes. Feeds are built in batches of up to 200 products with saved checkpoints, COD statements are read line by line instead of loaded whole, and order lists are read from the database in limited batches.
